# Loquen 0.1.48
- **Fast after a break.** Loquen keeps its speech engine warm while you are not dictating, so the first dictation after a pause is as quick as the rest. On an 8 GB Mac it used to take several seconds. - **AI cleanup is now off by default** for new installs. Qwen already adds punctuation and capitals, and skipping cleanup makes every dictation faster. You can turn it on in Settings ▸ Cleanup.
# Loquen 0.1.47
- **Faster on Macs with 8 GB of memory.** Loquen now keeps the speech model in memory, so the first dictation after a break no longer takes many seconds while the model loads back in. - **No wait for AI cleanup when it cannot help.** A dictation that is only a command, like "insert date", skips cleanup. And if cleanup runs out of time 3 times in a row on your Mac, Loquen pauses it until the next launch instead of adding a delay to every dictation. Settings ▸ Cleanup tells you when that happens.
# Loquen 0.1.45
- **Numbers said the short way.** "One forty over ninety" now types 140 over 90, and "one sixty-two pounds" types 162. Before, they came out as "1 40". When a dose word follows, as in "one fifty milligram tablet", Loquen leaves the numbers apart, because that could mean one 50 mg tablet.
# Loquen 0.1.43
The first public build with Qwen3-ASR, Loquen's new speech engine.
- **Qwen3-ASR 1.7B is now the speech engine.** In testing on medical dictation it made far fewer word errors than the earlier engines, and it gets drug names right much more often. It runs entirely on your Mac. - **One-time 2.2 GB download.** The first launch downloads the Qwen model, shows progress, and picks up where it left off if your connection drops. Every file is checked before use. After that, nothing about your speech leaves your Mac. - **Drug-name recheck.** When a medication name sounds uncertain, Loquen checks it again against your enabled vocabulary packs. - **Faster long dictations.** Loquen transcribes long dictations in pieces while you are still talking, so the text lands a few seconds after you let go. - **Hands-free fixed.** A double tap of fn starts hands-free mode again, and a tap cancels. Key presses were being measured in the wrong unit on Apple Silicon. - **Paste last (⌃⌘V) fixed**, and it pastes exactly once per press. - **Spoken punctuation cleaned up.** "New line", "new paragraph" and "period" no longer leave an extra period behind. - **Safer pasting.** In apps where Loquen cannot confirm the paste, such as Messages, your old clipboard now stays away long enough that the app always pastes your dictation. - **Redaction wording.** A name after "the patient" no longer becomes "the patient the patient".
Requires macOS 15 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac, and about 3 GB of free disk space.
